gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-cham: Loud, spread-out letters up top. Noto Sans Cham sits beneath with tall, rounded lowercase and open curves, so the heading gets to show off while the text stays easygoing.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Paprika throws its scattered, hollow-reed letters across the line like capitals. Noto Sans Cherokee is the better talker of the two, a tall band of lettering with an e that leaves a wide gap at its terminal.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian reads as a plain sans with a large x-height, short ascenders and curves that stop short of closing. And if Paprika were shrunk down, its expressive spacing would lose the commanding presence it has up large.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Big, brash and widely spaced. Noto Sans Coptic keeps the middle zone of the line dominant, with open mouths on the s and c, so it makes a quieter plain sans neighbor for Paprika's shouting.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Noto Sans Cuneiform answers with puffed, glass-bead lowercase and an e that opens up, so both fonts feel generous but only Paprika is shouting.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Paprika scatters its letters wide, with hollow-reed counters that feel expressive and commanding. Noto Sans Deseret follows with open apertures and a squat, wide-looking lowercase, which gives the heading's drama somewhere friendly to land.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Approachable is not the word for Paprika, which is commanding, with lowercase that fills the line like capitals. Noto Sans Devanagari is the compact one, so a long passage would run smoothly, its open g and blended skyline never getting in the way.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Paprika's lowercase swells to fill the line like capitals, with letters scattered at a distance. Duployan's wide-mouthed a and oversized counters make a plain sans that would read comfortably.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Showy letters, hollow-reed counters. Paprika is best at taking over a line with capital-sized lowercase, while Noto Sans Elbasan is best at large lowercase forms with open terminals that never pinch shut.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic keeps its apertures open throughout and its ascenders barely clear the x-height, which is a modest, clean look. Paprika's scattered, expansive letters then take the louder role above it.
